csv_project_name: Design for LCCC Student Lounge Renovation
csv_scope_of_work: Laramie County Community College is seeking proposals from qualified architectural firms to provide design services for the renovation of an existing Student Lounge. The primary goal of this project is to transform the space through high-impact interior improvements that foster social interaction, recreation, and community-building . LCCC has three campus sites: the main campus in Cheyenne WY and satellite campus locations in Pine Bluffs WY and Laramie WY. 1. Flooring, 2. Interior Finishes and Paint, 3. Furniture and Layout, 4. Lighting Design, 5. Audio-Visual and Technology Integration, 6. Electrical and Power Accessibility
